purpose: Measure literal-model repeat variability before attributing V3 rank/raw differences to transport, GPU assignment, backend flags or any other cause.

invariant_numerical_contract.base: Original14 model320/native384/FOV140/K94/two anatomical mirror views/mean of plain and mirror. Original chunk16, FP16 path and existing fallback behavior remain literal.
invariant_numerical_contract.author224: Exact extracted stock nine symbols: crop307 offset38, bilinear224 align_corners=False, ImageNet normalization, full94-window single FP16 forward, no chunk changes. FP32 fallback remains fatal to qualification.
invariant_numerical_contract.reader: Original k16/three checkpoints/decoder/label order/target coefficients unchanged. Run at most once only if fused-rank diagnostics require it.
invariant_numerical_contract.fusion: Original target fusion preserved; fixed90:10 all12 is recomputation for diagnosis only.

dispatch_controls.fixed_assignment: Cohort ordinal modulo2, exactly16 studies on each GPU; both identical models loaded on both GPUs.
dispatch_controls.keep_worker_count_and_declared_total_que: Original nproc/outstanding settings and bounded total queue48 retained. Fixed routing must not grow the prepared-object bound.
dispatch_controls.implementation_diff_must_be_separate_rec: Fixed routing may require queue ownership changes; record those orchestration changes explicitly. Do not claim ordinary-vs-fixed comparison isolates GPU mapping if queue/arrival behavior differs.
dispatch_controls.comparison_scope: Within-policy A/A measures repeat variability. Cross-policy comparison is descriptive until a matched routing control demonstrates the dispatch change alone.

observation_and_persistence.raw_probabilities: Capture CPU float32 raw12 before any rank; capture per-view raw12 where available without adding GPU forward or tensor-copy calls. Preserve exact float32 bits and round-trip decimal CSV.
observation_and_persistence.UID_device_identity: Thread-local current-study context, per-study UID hash, actual CUDA device and view index; never use a shared global current UID across two consumers.
observation_and_persistence.input: Per-study original uint8 volume/mask SHA, shape/dtype/valid slots, actual worker FOV and source SHA. All phases must equal the same per-UID hashes.
observation_and_persistence.load: Checkpoint byte SHA, architecture, strict load result, tensor count and shape/dtype manifest SHA, 12-head shape, device; no checkpoint tensors in receipts.
backend_flags: cuda.matmul allow_tf32 and reduced-precision reduction flags
float32 matmul precision and deterministic-algorithms/warn-only state
torch/timm/CUDA/cuDNN/device properties and available driver version
observation_and_persistence.backend_policy: Read actual values before source setup, before inference and after phase. Preserve source setters benchmark=True and matmul.allow_tf32=True; do not alter flags, warm-up order, seed or determinism in this diagnostic.
observation_and_persistence.resources: Per-phase elapsed/RSS/disk, sampled per-device GPU peak and torch allocated/reserved peak, actual model/backbone forward counts, input shape/dtype/no_grad/AMP/fallback/cleanup counters.
observation_and_persistence.write_order: Create a fresh phase directory and exclusive receipts. Persist each completed study's compact raw and identity receipt; persist whole-phase raw CSV and full compact JSON immediately on completion, before any between-phase assertion.
observation_and_persistence.failure: Finally persist a distinct exclusive failed-phase receipt with completed UID hashes, actual counters/resources, exception and cleanup outcome. Keep previous phase outputs. Partial phase is never labeled complete.
observation_and_persistence.observer_effect: Observe source-returned CPU arrays and metadata. Record new hooks/timing overhead; scheduling variation introduced by observation is itself not a proven transport defect.
observation_and_persistence.diagnostic_submission_deletion: Delete only the workspace diagnostic submission.csv in finally, including mismatch/failure; never submit any profile CSV.

independent_measurements: Same-source A/A absolute raw differences and exact float32 ULP counts (median/p99/max), SHA identity, changed cells and finite range.
All12 average-percentile ranks, tie relation changes, pair-order flips and implicated UID hashes.
Original-vs-bounded differences stratified by equal/different observed UID device assignment; do not infer cause from correlation.
Stock224 same-device A/A raw and ranks; shared224-vs-stock224 matched control is a later root-reviewed phase, not automatically rerun here.
Per-phase strict original ordinal-rank contract: interpret CSV numbers as float32, compare exactly to float32(k/(N-1)); retain tied-group rank-set audit and cross-control CSV byte identity.
Exact independent original target fusion, plus hypothetical fixed90:10 final ranks only if the same once-run reader cache is available.

unreached_old_checker_defect.condition: Float64 exact k/(N-1) was compared to Pandas serialization of original ranks.astype(np.float32).
unreached_old_checker_defect.scope: Local checker discrepancy, separate from actualV3 line556 failure.
unreached_old_checker_defect.future_correction: Compare exact float32 interpretation using standard-library struct; preserve ordinal rank sets and no numeric tolerance. Old checker remains immutable.

decision_rules.when_same_source_AA_differs: Quantify repeat noise and describe scope. No claim that transport or expert changed the mathematical function follows without matched controls.
decision_rules.when_same_device_AA_still_differs: UID GPU mapping alone cannot explain all observed variation. Observe backend state/order; do not switch precision or backend policy automatically.
decision_rules.when_expert_ranks_equal_but_raw_differs: Record rank stability only. This neither passes the raw reproduction gate nor proves improved AUC.
decision_rules.after_measurement: Root may review a separately justified future contract or request another single-factor diagnostic. Existing V3 failure and criteria remain recorded.

prerun_artificial_requirements: Exact source diff: original numerical functions, checkpoints, 14/19/21/V1/V2/V3 packages protected; only new profile observation/dispatch/persistence files.
Many-study CPU routing exact-once, deterministic fixed assignments, queue bounds, producer/consumer failure drain/task_done and no hangs.
Thread-local UID/view identities remain correct under two simultaneous consumers.
Exclusive writes preserve completed phase values on forced later mismatch and failed in-phase inference; no fake success.
Float32 rank CSV serialization and ULP edge-case tests, plus malformed/nonfinite/missingUID/wronghash refusal.
Reader replay commands/dependency paths/preflight exact p010 alias, real Notebook stdout lifetime probe before models.
